Boggart.description: Boggarts are small, squat goblinoids with bestial features, natural magic, and a knack for potions. Found in the realm of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.

Flamekin.description: Flamekin are elemental people made from fire and stone, with innate flame magic and fire resistance. They pursue the Path of Flame.

Lorwyn Changeling.description: Lorwyn changelings are fey shapeshifters who can assume humanoid or beast forms, with superior darkvision and charming counterfeits.

Rimekin.description: Rimekin are ice-touched kin of flamekin with cold magic, cold resistance, and darkvision. Their flames burn icy blue.
